text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks before the Fan Appreciation 
Festival.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...With Win Variation at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival, huh."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I permit it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I will not say it twice. ...Choose the 
distance yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had heard Orfevre was a whimsical and 
difficult Umamusume. I never expected her 
to grant permission so easily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, the stage is set. All that's 
left is to pray for a miracle on the 
day...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's the Fan Appreciation 
Festival~! The time for the specialty 
event races has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The first race is 2500m clockwise! Many 
Umamusume active in the Twinkle Series are 
running today~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! The real deal! So awesome, she's 
running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
right?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Bari-yan! Do your best! Hang in there 
today too and tear that victory away!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...I see. Nobody knows that this is going 
to be the last time.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry. But I'm... already at my 
limit.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the massive cheers echoing across 
the racecourse, the race began!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...The cheering... it hurts.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I used to be so proud of it. I wanted to 
be the main star who received even more.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I just... gh. ...No. No, I don't 
want to run.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to go to a normal school. Study, 
hang out, and go camping in the autumn 
instead of racing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it'd be fun. Peaceful, too. A 
life like that would be nice. Something 
like—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre!!! Surging from behind, blowing 
past the field! The pack now hits the 
final stretch!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
...Woooah, look, Shion! That girl's 
amazing. The blonde one who just rounded 
the final corner. Is she seriously a new 
student just like us...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (The day I first saw Orfevre—)

text_block_list.name: Newly Enrolled Sion
text_block_list.text: That girl... is glowing.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Newly Enrolled Sion
text_block_list.text:
"She's... glowing...! Sparkling, 
blazing... so bright!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(That girl, doing so effortlessly what I 
could never manage to do—)

text_block_list.name: Newly Enrolled Sion
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice, that's so amazing, so 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Enviable, cool, and beautiful...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I looked up to them, and when I reached 
out to touch that world, I wasn't even 
close to their level.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The distance that won't close, the back 
fading into the distance. Leaving behind a 
scorching, brilliant glow.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Looking up again and again and again, so 
many times—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I grew to hate the sight of that golden 
figure. Yet, before I knew it, my eyes 
were always chasing after her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Every day, I'd step up full of spirit, 
only to be crushed. It didn't take long 
for admiration to turn into hatred.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Even so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm racing against her, I can get 
more engrossed than doing anything else—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see—the light.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I was chasing the light.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Always.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Damn it, damn it, damn it, screw this!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre crosses the finish line in first 
place!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAHH...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (This is the end.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Thank goodness.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I was supposed to feel relieved...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I was supposed to feel relieved, and 
yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...N... No! Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: No...! No, no! I don't want it to end yet!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... ...I don't want it to end like 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first match of the specialty races 
held at the Fan Appreciation Festival was 
an absolute hit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stood frozen in the middle of the turf, 
surrounded by roaring cheers and 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Or... fe...-san...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Why such a look on your face? What 
troubles you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...W-Well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! Dammit, I already decided to quit, 
didn't I...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...E-Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Saying she's "quitting"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation, who went dashing off the 
track.
choice_data_list:
(I want to chase after her right now! 
But—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I'm there, it might make her waver in 
her final decision.
choice_data_list:
(There's nothing more I can say. But 
please—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hope she still feels like running again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation, who went dashing off the 
track.

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait? Wonder what's up with Bari-yan. 
Is it 'cause she couldn't beat Orfe after 
all...?

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"We really were just one step away, huh. 
But that's exactly why I think we can win 
next time."

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Right? She'll definitely win her next 
race. She ran in the Nikkei Sho recently, 
so... maybe the Tenno Sho (Spring) is 
next!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, there were many voices praising 
and placing high hopes on Win Variation.
choice_data_list:
（……I want to chase after her right now! 
But—）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I'm there, it might make her waver in 
her final decision.
choice_data_list:
(There's nothing more I can say. But 
please—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hope she still feels like running again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The expectant murmurs rippling through 
the stands did not cease for quite a 
while.
